In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the influence of eWOM is positive on consumer buying intentions.
electronic word of mouth is an effective marketing strategy and that the more people that are reached by the electronic word of mouth the more likely it is to be effective.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that the influence of eWOM on consumer buying intention is not linear.
it is the first to examine the effects of eWOM on the consumer’s buying intention in a social media context.
we have developed a new model for electronic WOM, and that this model has been tested in the context of a specific product category, namely the mobile phone industry.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the influence of eWOM is not a one-size-fits-all phenomenon.
consumers who are more likely to use electronic word of mouth are more likely to be influenced by electronic word of mouth, which in turn leads to higher purchase intention.
the impact of eWOM on purchase intentions depends on the extent to which the information in eWOM is congruent with a consumer's own knowledge and beliefs.
